findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: email_check, page_meta, payment_precheck · Private data: federal_register, drug_shortages, filings_latest, email_check, base_token_check, payment_precheck · Public sink: pypi_package, email_check, isbn_lookup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: email_check, page_meta, payment_precheck · Private data: federal_register, drug_shortages, filings_latest, email_check, base_token_check, payment_precheck · Public sink: pypi_package, email_check, isbn_lookup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
